issues.description: Hard examples 8 and 9 are repetitions of examples 6 and 5, reducing the diversity and educational value.
The limit explanation contains minor inaccuracies in describing the behavior of h(y) near t₀, though the conclusion is correct.

strengths: Excellent use of real olympiad problems with specific references (1998, 2002, 2012)
Full coverage of the required structure with all 9 sections
Mathematical correctness verified through concrete value testing
suggestions: Replace repetitive hard examples with distinct olympiad problems to enhance depth
Clarify the limit analysis in Example 4 (2002 problem) for smoother student comprehension
verdict_reasoning: The article excels in mathematical rigor and olympiad relevance but loses one point due to repetitive hard examples. Minor issues don't compromise overall quality, making it suitable for students.
